title: 785. K-th Smallest Prime Fraction

examples.explanation: Ordered quotients start 1/5, 1/3, 2/5, so the third is [2,5].
The fourth quotient in order is 1/5.

hints: Compare two quotients a/b and c/d by cross products a*d versus c*b to avoid floating point.
With modest sizes, enumerating all pairs and sorting is simple and fast enough.
For large inputs, binary-search the value and count how many quotients fall below the midpoint.
